limitations: No live queue, account, publish, ad provider or action reconciliation was performed.
Paused state is a local specification; no remote paused-creation guarantee was exercised.
Admin authorization is a prepared contract; live all-host/cache/identity checks were not exercised.
Production signup ingestion and qualified conversion acceptance were not tested.
This measures one independent reader applying prose instructions, not distributional reliability across repeated model runs.
runtime: Independent Codex subagent with inherited session defaults; exact model/runtime and decoding parameters were not separately recorded.
